core_claim: TV's 'Golden Age' is real but small — the floor of drama quality rose a third of an IMDb point while the ceiling stayed put, and the bigger story is a 10.5x explosion in the number of shows.

edt_01.label: Hook — pick a season from the cloud
edt_01.title: Look at the cloud first
edt_01.editorial_notes: The full scatter (2,266 dots) is the centerpiece. Reader-quiz interaction should land BEFORE we explain the answer — it makes the surprise (ceiling didn't move) felt rather than told.

edt_02.label: The Golden Age is real — but small
edt_02.title: A quarter of a point
edt_02.editorial_notes: 7.88 → 8.17 must be exact. +0.31 era lift must be exact.

edt_03.label: The ceiling stayed where it was
edt_03.title: The ceiling did not move
edt_03.editorial_notes: 1995 vs 2017 numbers (8.96 → 8.90; 7.01 → 7.23; 7.80 → 8.12) must be exact. This is the counterintuitive turn.

edt_04.label: Peak TV — the volume explosion
edt_04.title: Ten times as many shows
edt_04.editorial_notes: 22 → 230, 10.5x. Mention Landgraf's 487 figure as external corroboration. A short generated clip of cascading TV screens or fanning channels would land the volume feeling well.

edt_05.label: The marquee climbs — Sopranos, Wire, Breaking Bad, Mad Men, GoT
edt_05.title: What rising actually looks like
edt_05.editorial_notes: Breaking Bad 8.71→9.55 must be exact. GoT S7 dip (9.30) must be exact — that is the foreshadowing of S8. A YouTube embed of Breaking Bad's Ozymandias trailer / official preview would ground the prestige-era story in a real, embeddable artefact.

edt_06.label: The flame-out — Dexter, NYPD Blue, Bloodline
edt_06.title: When the climb reverses
edt_06.editorial_notes: Dexter 9.15 → 6.95 (Δ -2.20) must be exact. NYPD Blue 8.32 → 4.70 (Δ -3.62) must be exact. The det_04 self-selection caveat must be visible — it is essential context for why collapses are so steep.

edt_07.label: Genre drift — Horror won the Golden Age
edt_07.title: Horror won, Sci-Fi lost
edt_07.editorial_notes: Horror +0.90, Sci-Fi -0.20, Thriller -0.30 must all be exact. A short atmospheric image (e.g. genre-collage or single horror still) would help break the chart density without forcing a video.

edt_08.label: What 'Golden' actually means — three things at once
edt_08.title: Three things at once
edt_08.editorial_notes: Synthesis section. The three big stat callouts (10.5x, +0.31, ceiling 8.96 → 8.90) should be visually loud here. Breaking Bad 9.55 vs Parenthood 9.68 comparison must be exact.

edt_09.label: Close — back to the cloud
edt_09.title: Look at the cloud again
edt_09.editorial_notes: Re-show the scatter (or refer back to it). The reader should leave with a different reading than they arrived with.
